text: Time is of the essence regarding payment obligations. If the Allottee/Buyer defaults in paying any installment by the scheduled milestone date, interest shall be charged at 18% per annum compounded monthly under Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority Regulations, 2018.

title: Clause: Sanctioned Building Approvals
